action.objective: Commit Bxg4, eliminating the Black knight and recovering the bishop while retaining a decisive material and positional advantage.
action.rationale: h3g4 is the only commit-ready move. Verified at full depth 4 with exact score 3274; safety complete with no mating reply and tactical_refutation not_found. The line h3g4 h5g4 e4f6 g8h8 d7c7 shows Black's recapture hxg4 forced, then Nf6+ wins the c7 pawn and keeps White up a full rook plus bishop for a pawn. It captures the loose knight on g4 while the rook on d7 dominates. No refutations or replan events.
